description: 14.7's BL-2, pinned in the direction it belongs. This exact payload was a SchemaValidity fixture expecting Accepted: a dietary goal may rewrite the recipe's own title, so accepting it meant a creator could take "Gluten-Free" into the canonical recipe and publish a free-from claim that no record supports. The caution beside it does not redeem it — a caution explains a consequence, it does not license a claim.
